in_marathi.name: Chitrapriya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Loved by God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chitrapriya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chitrapriya is a Sanskrit female name that translates to 'Loved by God'. It is a name of deep spiritual significance and is often given to girls in Hindu communities.

vedic_reference.note: This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'चित्र' (chitra) which means 'art'. The suffix '-प्रिया' (-priyā) means 'beloved'. Hence, the name Chitrapriya means 'Beloved of the God of Art'.
